_about: Item rarity tiers, lowest to highest. An item's `rarity` in items.json is one of these ids; it sets the colour of its name and border. Loot tables roll a rarity first, then an item listed under that rarity. `suffix`: common gear that drops at this tier gains a WoW-style suffix (its magical property). `drops: false` tiers never come from loot tables.

rarities.name: Junk
rarities.desc: Grey. Worth a few coins to a merchant and nothing else.

rarities.name: Common
rarities.desc: White. Plain weapons and armour with no magical properties.

rarities.name: Enhanced
rarities.desc: Green. Gear with a magical property, such as a bonus stat.

rarities.name: Rare
rarities.desc: Blue. A very low drop chance, or from bosses and quest chains.

rarities.name: Epic
rarities.desc: Purple. The best gear in the game, kept for bosses.

rarities.name: Legendary
rarities.desc: Orange. A small handful of items with a story.

rarities.name: Quest
rarities.desc: Quest items: kept until handed in.
